name: Curried Chicken Salad Lettuce Wraps with Apple, Raisins & Cilantro
ingredients: 1 (30 oz) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince shallot; place in a medium bowl.
Add yogurt, mayo, curry powder, and salt to the bowl with the shallot; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and small dice apples; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Place chicken on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces, add to the bowl, and stir to combine the chicken salad.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with chicken salad and enjoy!
author: Mealime
